items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Well, I told Alfred that I was doing a date with that particular band.

ctx.x: At the time you and Brew were playing with Machito, did that record date you did for Blue Note come about with you and Brew and J.J.?

Yeah... Well, I told Alfred that I was doing a date with that particular band. So he sounded me whether I'd want to do a date for Blue Note with that band. Shit, I said, 'Why not? Let's see what we can get going.' And I made two or three albums with Blue Note.
I know afterwards you made one with Tal Farlow, I think.
